model_annotation: This bar chart visually compares the relative contributions or frequencies of six medical specialties—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—across six distinct categories or time points, represented by vertical bar groups. The horizontal axis displays these six groups, each containing six colored bars corresponding to the specialties, while the vertical axis (though unlabeled and without visible scale) indicates magnitude, with bar heights reflecting relative values. The legend at the top assigns colors: light blue for Cardio, light orange for Gastro, medium orange for Infect, dark orange for Neuro, medium brown for Obstetrics, and dark brown for Pediatrics. Within each group, the bars are arranged in consistent order from left to right, and their heights vary, suggesting differing levels of contribution per specialty per group. Notably, the Cardio bars (light blue) are consistently the shortest across all groups, while Pediatrics (dark brown) and Obstetrics (medium brown) often appear among the tallest, indicating higher values. The chart does not include numerical labels, axis titles, or gridlines, and the background is blurred, focusing attention on the bar patterns and relative comparisons among specialties within each group.
